quote: After consuming the tea, you gain a +2 item bonus to all initiative rolls for 1 hour and gain the following reaction.
duration: 1 hour (4 hours with the Tea Ceremony activation)

modifiers.appliesWhen: on initiative rolls

note: The text says "all initiative rolls", so it covers initiative rolled with Perception or with a skill (Stealth, Deception, …); `all-checks` plus the appliesWhen condition is the only encoding in ModeTargetKind that reaches both, and being conditional it stars those stats rather than folding into any number. It also grants the Evade Peril reaction: turn a failed Reflex save into a success, reducing the tea's remaining duration by 1 hour (ending it if that hits 0). Tea Ceremony extends the duration to 4 hours.
